The '''Razor Shyracks''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kestas Rone]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were believed to have been responsible for six attacks on the Republic prior to an attempted [[Battle of Javaal|ambush]] on a Republic patrol group over [[Javaal]], where they were destroyed.
